title: Axial Brain CT of Middle Cerebral Artery Infarction
author: Lucien Monfils
caption: Non-contrast axial head CT demonstrating a hypodense middle cerebral artery (MCA) territory ischemic stroke with mass effect.
alt_text: Axial CT scan of the brain showing a large hypodense infarct in the middle cerebral artery distribution.
clinical_relevance: Demonstrates acute ischemic stroke neuroimaging used on Earth vs. spaceflight diagnostic limitations where head CT is unavailable (CLIFF-059, p.5-7).
